_doc: Pose templates of s5_clipfit.py and s5_limbfit.py per donor body type, and the clip names per classic mode. A template parameter turns each named bone by value x weight degrees about the world axis given (x: side axis, + leans forward; y: up; z: forward), about the bone's bind joint; 'cog' also takes the translations tx and tz (bind units). 'base' is the template's rest pose (bones turned before the parameters). biped_d2r fits a D2R biped bound in a T-pose (arms along x, bone names as the Dried Corpse's: cog, spine_01, chest, neck, head, L_/R_UpperArm, ForeArm, Wrist, Thigh, Calf, Foot, Ball); its base hangs the arms down. The arm parameters assume that T-pose bind: on it an x turn before the hang-down only twists the arm, so the arms never swing forward. s5_limbfit.py turns its arms after the hang-down instead (arm_fix, on by default; --old-arms is the old order); s5_clipfit.py still applies the template as written, so check the arm swing on a test pose for a new donor, and write a new template for an A-pose donor.

monster_keys._doc: The keys of the monster config's "clipfit" block (common.mcfg('clipfit')).
monster_keys.part_mask: the colour test of the rigid part in classic's frames: {"b_min": B, "b_over_rg": D} passes opaque pixels with blue >= B and blue - max(red, green) > D; "loose": a looser test of the same shape for the outline check; "edge_min": the share of the part outline that must lie on loose-test pixels (default 0.62) for a frame's part mask to count
monster_keys.part_weight: weight of the part IoU in the score (default 0.5)
monster_keys.edge_weight: weight of our part outline on classic's part colour (default 0.5)
monster_keys.shell_bone: the corpse shell bone, put under the floor in every written clip (default the monster's shell_bone)
monster_keys.shell_drop: how far under the floor, in bind units (default 12)
monster_keys.loop: the modes that loop (smoothing and Catmull-Rom wrap around), e.g. ["wl", "nu", "rn"]
monster_keys.camera: the per-facing camera json {"views": {"<facing>": {"az": degrees}}}, a path under the work folder or absolute (looked up through the art store); "caprim" is accepted as an older name
monster_keys.el: the elevation of classic's sprite camera in degrees (default 35)
